[[File:Jabbas_city_house-Mos_Espa.jpg|250px|thumb|Jabba's city house (4), seen on a map of Mos Espa]]
'''Jabba's city house''' referred to an urban dwelling once utilized by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] in the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]]. Located along [[Mos Espa Way/Legends|Mos Espa Way]], the house was one of the most imposing buildings in the city.
